Second Shift, repair routing, obligations, startup and current-state reconciliation fail closed on job/lane violations, stale owner heads, overlapping mutation claims, false execution readiness or retired-system resurrection.

carried_forward_expectations: All non-conflicting expectations from EXPECTATION-REGISTRY-006 remain historical guidance; this registry controls conflicts about Programming peer admission, Website Building ownership, Topology 007 lane coverage, Prose lifecycle and owner boundaries.
change_rule: Changing a system job, completion standing, retired standing, peer admission, execution readiness, ownership route or cross-lane exception requires explicit user direction and a current successor authority transaction.
